_doc: Waking up from a nap on a bench in the open (BenchNap, world/nap_gags.gd). If it rained while you slept you wake up soaked; otherwise `chance` of the time one of the other gags happens (`overnight` after a whole night on a bench, the way a day ends until you own a bed), weighted, never the same one twice in a row. {name} is the villager caught staring, {paper} the local paper. A gag with "visual": true is a sight gag and has no lines: it plays out first, with nothing on screen explaining it, and only then comes the usual greeting. A layout can override any key with its own "naps" block (a city's paper, its own odds).

lines: You wake up under yesterday's {paper}. The wind takes it back.
Somebody tucked you in with the {paper}. The sports pages leave first.
You slept under the {paper}'s classifieds. One of them was for a mattress. The wind takes that one too.
Somebody left a wet umbrella open beside the bench to dry. It dried on you.
An umbrella stands open next to you, dripping. Its owner has very dry feet somewhere.
A stranger's umbrella spent the night drying over your left side. Your left side did not dry.
